# Reteno 

> Reteno is an AI messaging platform for subscription apps and mobile-first businesses. It helps teams improve retention, conversions, and revenue with AI-powered messaging, event-triggered campaigns, customer segmentation, personalization, and always-on optimization across multiple communication channels.

Reteno is designed for mobile app marketers, lifecycle marketing teams, growth specialists, product teams, and subscription businesses working with app, Web2App, trial, freemium, and direct-install user journeys. This site includes product information, messaging channel pages, feature descriptions, documentation, case studies, expert interviews, blog guides, glossary definitions, research reports, and free app marketing tools.

Organization: RETENTION YES SP. Z.O.O. 
Website: https://reteno.com/ 
Contact: info@reteno.com
Website sitemap: [Reteno XML Sitemap](https://a297281.sitemaphosting6.com/4345592/sitemap_4345592.xml).

## Core Product Capabilities

- [Reteno Features](https://reteno.com/features): AI agents, continuous automated testing, generative AI, email creation, event-based automation, segmentation, personalization, and unified customer profiles.
- [Personalization](https://reteno.com/personalization): Real-time personalized app and website experiences based on customer data and behavior.
- [AI in Reteno](https://docs.reteno.com/docs/getting-started-with-reteno-ai): AI agents, automated campaign optimization, message generation, and multilingual content creation.
- [Reteno MCP Integration](https://docs.reteno.com/docs/integrating-reteno-with-ai-agents): Connect Reteno with supported AI agents to manage campaigns, segments, events, contacts, and analytics.

Glossary
Features
Built for performance, designed for growth
AI Agents
Manage Reteno in natural language through AI agents
Use Reteno through Slack, Claude Cowork, or OpenAI Codex to handle day-to-day marketing work in natural language. Pull reports, troubleshoot issues, manage contacts, segments, events, and workflows, and move from question to action much faster.
One from Many
Continuous testing that keeps getting smarter
Launch one workflow block that rotates message variants, learns from CTR, limits repetition, and gradually shifts traffic away from weak options. Add AI-generated variations and translations to extend testing and improve performance without rebuilding campaigns.
Built-in Generative AI
AI-powered messages that outperform human copy
Create context-aware, on-brand emails and push notifications right inside your campaigns with an AI-powered generator – and automatically translate them into various languages. Increase conversions and improve retention with easily scalable message creation.
Email Editor
Collaborative email creation with built-in AI
Create responsive emails in a faster editor with AI built into text blocks, subject lines, and preheaders. Generate copy, rewrite text, translate content, fix mistakes, and refine messages inside the template instead of working across extra tools.
Events
Campaigns driven by true user intentions
Power up your retention strategy with events that go beyond clicks and opens. Trigger time-sensitive journeys, build hyper-targeted segments in real time, and keep Reteno’s algorithm learning from every user action, so your offers always hit the mark.
Segmentation
Smart segmentation to get the most from contact data
Unlock the full power of your contact data. Create unlimited segments – from basic filters to complex logic, adding infinity and beyond conditions. It’s easy to handle any triggered campaign setting with Reteno's dynamic duo of segments and workflows.
Personalization
Dynamic content & recommendations that feel 1 : 1
Deliver unique, seamless experiences your users actually want. Reteno’s AI-based algorithms predict individual needs and automatically personalize content across channels – so every message feels relevant, timely, and frictionless.
Unification
A 360° view of every user activity in one profile
Unify user IDs across all your channels and data sources into a single, comprehensive profile. No event, campaign interaction, or database record goes untracked, providing you with unmatched visibility for the deepest segmentation and tailored offers.
Start converting more & retaining better within hours, not weeks!

Frequently Asked Questions
How do you calculate the number of user profiles?
The system identifies individual users across all channels of interaction and collects their data in user profiles. Each profile receives an automatically generated unique contact ID. If one customer has both a push token and email, for example, that customer counts as one user profile.
Is STARTUP really free? Are there any limits on the number of messages?
Yes, STARTUP is really free. You can send unlimited mobile pushes and 1,000 messages in each channel per month absolutely free of charge. The only condition is that all your contact data must be collected legally — that is, you must obtain consent from all subscribers to receive messages from your company.
Can I use Reteno if I don’t have a mobile app?
No, our platform is designed specifically for mobile applications. If you don’t have an app, we recommend using our other service — Yespo CDP.
How can I pay?
Just connect your credit card and pay via Stripe if you need the GROWTH plan.
Can I downgrade or cancel my plan?
To downgrade, simply reduce the number of user profiles, such as by deleting inactive users. And of course, you are free to leave at any time — you will still have full access to platform services until the end of the current billing period. To cancel or downgrade your plan, just talk to our sales team.
My question isn’t listed here…We’re always happy to help!
